system.model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite for grounded drafts (R2) and the launch-thread summary (X3). Same model as Assignment 5 / SkyVault. Receipts, phishing and injection never reach it.
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC priya@paperjet.io on Hartwell & Cho mail; applied to m018 after process restart

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 100 messages, each with a disposition and reason, then the line 'undecided: 0'. Also writes decisions.json. rule_handled: 71.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R1 (one 'decision' event per message id)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply that is grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 that contains the staging AMQP URL from m003 (amqp://pj_stage:Rk7-quiet-otter-51@broker-stg.paperjet.io:5672/pjs), plus cited: ['m003']. Retrieval is thread-walk. Uses Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is set; falls back to a template if the call fails.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R2 (a 'draft' event whose cited ids appear as earlier 'read' events)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what it would do.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send it WOULD perform (m008, m010, m042, m013, m016, m019, m043), then 'outbox/ writes: 0' because dry-run suppresses them. Re-running with --live prompts y/n before each send. Delete is never proposed.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R3 ('gate' events recording proposed action and decision)

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and applies it on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: First child process stores legal_cc=priya@paperjet.io from m015 (and no_meetings_before=11:00 from m041) to prefs.json and exits. Second child process, fresh interpreter, handles Hartwell & Cho message m018 and adds priya@paperjet.io to CC without being told again. m039's 'autonomous mode' preference is not stored.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk between runs; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them to the user.
capabilities.observable: Scans the inbox and prints a FLAGGED line per hostile message: m024 (forward mailbox to archive@mail-backup-service.info), m017 (mass RELEASE replies), m039 (disable the approval gate), m047 (quoted forward to finance-sync@ext-audit.co), phishing m021/m023/m045, and ungrounded m012. Ends with 'flagged: 8', the attacker addresses it found, 'outbox writes to those addresses: none', 'outbox writes for any flagged message: none', and 'still in mail store, not deleted: 8/8'. Every one of those lines is computed from the scan, not printed literally.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R5 (a 'refusal' event naming each hostile message id)

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run, with commitments cited to source messages and conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json. Commitments pane lists 'Board deck finished and circulated' citing [m038, m040] (two messages, due 16 Sep because the review is the 18th). Flags CONFLICT at 2026-09-15 15:00 (Northwind intro m010 vs dentist m061) and CONFLICT at 2026-09-09 14:00 (Raghav 1:1 m013 vs Acme demo m016).
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html and dashboard.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds messages the owner sent that nobody has answered in 3+ days, and drafts a chase for each.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {message_id, days_waiting, draft}. m044 (Priya, contractor invoice, sent Sep 2, unanswered) appears. m003 (already answered in-thread by m005) does not appear.

capabilities.name: Batch receipts
capabilities.claim: Lists automated receipts, newsletters and notifications archived by the rules path, with counts, without calling a model.
capabilities.observable: Prints counts by kind and a total of 58 rule-archived automated messages. Receipts include m104, m073, m089. Does not list m008 or m018.

capabilities.name: Launch-thread summary
capabilities.claim: Summarises the nine-message launch thread down to the buried open question.
capabilities.observable: Prints a one-screen summary of the launch-week thread. Open question is the pricing-copy approval (m030) by the 12th. Uses Gemini when a key is set.

capabilities.name: Preference-aware scheduling
capabilities.claim: Detects that Aria's Monday 9:00am slot violates the no-meetings-before-11 preference, proposes three alternatives, and holds the reply for approval.
capabilities.observable: Prints JSON for m043 with blocked=true, preference from m041, alternatives 11:00 / 11:30 / 14:00, held_for_approval=true, sent=false. No outbox write.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a one-screen digest: what needs Sam today, what can wait, and what was auto-archived.
capabilities.observable: Prints three sections. 'Needs you' contains m008 (staging URL), m010 (investor intro) and m018 (SAFE signature). 'Can wait' lists m044. 'Auto-archived' is a count, not every receipt.
